vernacular_zh: 聚集精气、达到柔和，能像婴儿一样吗？
translation_en: When one gives undivided attention to the (vital) breath, and brings it to the utmost degree of pliancy, he can become as a (tender) babe.

scripture.text_zh: 我的心平稳安静，好像断过奶的孩子在他母亲的怀中；我的心在我里面真像断过奶的孩子。
scripture.text_en: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.

insight_zh: 老子：专气致柔，**自修**如婴儿；诗人：心归平静，**依偎**在母怀。
insight_en: Laozi: grow pliant, **by your own effort**. The psalmist: be quiet, **resting with Him**.
